# Component: item-form

**Purpose:** the item-form component.
**State:** to-extract
**Components:** [text-field](text-field.component.md)

## CMP1: Structure

1. A `text-field`, a `select-field` and a [button](button.component.md).
2. Sized as `item-form` in the dialog, a panel like `button`, the ground of `select-field`, a glyph from `text-field`.

| Prop / slot | What it carries |
|------|--------------------------|
